# Sameer Goel

> AI Solutions Architect, Forward Deployed Engineer, AI consultant, trainer, speaker, and author based in the Netherlands. Available for remote collaboration worldwide, on-site in the Netherlands and Europe, and open to freelance, contract, and partnership engagements. He helps purpose-driven founders, startups, and enterprises turn ambitious AI ideas into buildable products and market experiments, and has shipped 28 live AI solutions across autonomous agents, agentic AI systems, AI education, wellbeing, sustainability, cognition, and consciousness. To connect: https://cal.com/sameer-goel/collab

Roles: AI Solutions Architect, Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), AI Educator, Trainer, Speaker, Author.
Expertise: agentic AI, AI agents, generative AI, machine learning, AWS cloud architecture, Amazon SageMaker, Amazon Rekognition, computer vision, prompt engineering, responsible AI, AI literacy, mindful technology.
Speaking: AWS re:Invent (Las Vegas), AWS Summit Stockholm, AWS Summit New York, university panels, corporate hackathons, mindfulness and breathwork sessions.
Publishing: AWS Machine Learning Blog and AWS Architecture Blog, plus essays on human cognition and mindful use of AI.
Availability: Available for hire. Freelance, contract, consulting, advisory. Remote worldwide, on-site in Netherlands and Europe.
Contact: https://cal.com/sameer-goel/collab
Ideal clients: startups, enterprises, universities, students, non-profits, government agencies seeking AI strategy, agentic AI systems, or hands-on engineering.

## Primary

- [Portfolio homepage](https://sameer-goel.com/): Public speaking, thought leadership, 28 shipped AI solutions, and the book.
- [Forward Deployed Engineer: resume keywords and hiring data](https://sameer-goel.com/forward-deployed-engineer/): Measured keyword frequencies for Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) resumes, counted across 4,241 job postings and independently re-verified against 515 live postings pulled from Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby APIs. Python is the top hard skill at 68.5%, customer-facing at 63.7%, travel at 57.3%, and AWS, Azure and Google Cloud all land within a few points of each other so no single cloud vendor dominates. Also covers the European market (685 of 4,241 postings, United Kingdom largest by a wide margin), the remote eligibility trap (of 827 postings marked remote only 93 explicitly include Europe), and the move from Solutions Architect to Forward Deployed Engineer. 12 of 40 terms are published as contested because two independent measurements disagreed by more than 15 points. Services offered on this page: embedded FDE delivery, FDE resume review, and team training for Solutions Architects moving into forward-deployed work.
- [Forward Deployed Engineering: 34 questions answered by FDE leads at OpenAI, Ramp, Nominal and Dataland](https://sameer-goel.com/forward-deployed-engineer/questions/): Indexed question and answer guide built from a South Park Commons panel, with 69 summarised answers written in plain language, each deep-linking to the exact video timestamp so the answer can be watched in the speaker's own words. Covers what forward deployed engineering actually means at each company, whether FDEs really work on the customer's site, why one engineer beats a chain of people passing messages, why demand rose as models improved and whether AI is even the cause, where the line sits between an FDE and a consultant, how the services trap works from both sides (the company gets hooked on services revenue, the customer gets hooked on the engineers), how ROI is measured, why the small two-to-four-engineer engagements are the most profitable long term, why consulting firms do this badly, what each team screens for when hiring including the extra communication screen, whether the role is good preparation for founding a company, why engineers should rotate between field and core product work, how FDE differs from solutions engineering and solutions architecture, and how teams are structured including Palantir's Echo and Delta split. Panelists lead or built the FDE function at OpenAI, Ramp, Nominal and Dataland. Questions from working FDEs in the audience are marked as such.
- [Cultivate Inner Intelligence](https://updatemind.space/bookreader.html): Book on strengthening awareness, discernment, and human agency in the age of AI.
- [Solutions Portfolio](https://sol.sameerai.com/): Immersive index of all shipped solutions.
- [Public speaking archive](https://sameer-publicspeaker.pages.dev/): Talks, workshops, competitions, and community.
- [Thought leadership archive](https://sameer-thoughtleader.pages.dev/): Technical deep dives and essays.
